newsitem.title: CHINA: Trading in CCT Telecom shares suspended.
newsitem.headline: Trading in CCT Telecom shares suspended.

text.p: Trading in shares of telecommunications equipment maker CCT Telecom Holdings Ltd was suspended on Monday at the company's request pending an announcement, the Hong Kong stock exchange said.
CCT Telecom shares rose HK$0.32 or 31.07 percent to HK$1.35 on Friday on volume of 676.26 million shares.
The company is exploring China's fledgling telecoms industry and is in preliminary talks with partners including Chinese Internet Corp (CIC), which is controlled by China's state Xinhua news agency.
Last week, CCT Telecom's managing director Bankee Kwan said the company had been in talks with CIC on a number of projects.
Kwan had also said CCT Telecom planned to invite other strategic shareholders and long-term investors into the company, but no names were mentioned.
